mapper.select: SELECT ID , LATITUDE , LONGITUDE FROM NODES WHERE REGION_ID = #{regionId}
SELECT ID , FROM_NODE_ID , TO_NODE_ID , LENGTH_M , OSM_HIGHWAY FROM EDGES WHERE REGION_ID = #{regionId} AND EXCLUDE_REASON IS NULL

SELECT NAME AS LABEL , LATITUDE , LONGITUDE , BLOCK_RADIUS_M , NULL AS EDGE_ID FROM CONSTRUCTION_ZONES WHERE REGION_ID = #{regionId} AND LATITUDE IS NOT NULL AND LONGITUDE IS NOT NULL AND START_DATE <= CURDATE() AND (END_DATE IS NULL OR CURDATE() <= END_DATE)
SELECT CAST(ID AS CHAR) AS LABEL , LATITUDE , LONGITUDE , BLOCK_RADIUS_M , EDGE_ID FROM OBSTACLE_REPORTS WHERE REGION_ID = #{regionId} AND SEVERITY = '높음' AND STATUS IN ('대기', '공개')

SELECT ID , NAME , ROAD_SEGMENT , LATITUDE , LONGITUDE , BLOCK_RADIUS_M , NOTE_LINE_JSON , DATE_FORMAT(START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS START_DATE , DATE_FORMAT(END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS END_DATE FROM CONSTRUCTION_ZONES WHERE REGION_ID = #{regionId} AND LATITUDE IS NOT NULL AND LONGITUDE IS NOT NULL AND START_DATE <= CURDATE() AND (END_DATE IS NULL OR CURDATE() <= END_DATE) ORDER BY END_DATE

SELECT ID , REGION_ID , ACTION , FROM_LAT , FROM_LNG , TO_LAT , TO_LNG , EDGE_KIND , NOTE , DATE_FORMAT(CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS CREATED_AT FROM MANUAL_EDGES WHERE REGION_ID = #{regionId} ORDER BY ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MANUAL_EDGES (REGION_ID, ACTION, FROM_LAT, FROM_LNG, TO_LAT, TO_LNG, EDGE_KIND, NOTE) VALUES (#{regionId}, #{action}, #{fromLat}, #{fromLng}, #{toLat}, #{toLng}, #{edgeKind}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT GEOMETRY_JSON FROM EDGES WHERE REGION_ID = #{regionId} AND EXCLUDE_REASON = 'steps' AND FROM_NODE_ID < TO_NODE_ID
